Package com.helix.core.ml

Class LocalModelRegistry

java.lang.Object
com.helix.core.ml.LocalModelRegistry
All Implemented Interfaces:
ModelRegistry
public class LocalModelRegistry extends Object implements ModelRegistry
In-memory and filesystem-backed implementation of ModelRegistry.

Provides thread-safe model registration, semantic version resolution, active version activation, and filesystem discovery for local ONNX model stores.
